name: Chain of Draft
description: Concise reasoning prompt with an explicit word budget.

prompts.draft_prompt: Solve the task using concise draft reasoning. Each intermediate reasoning step must be at most {max_words_per_step} words. Keep only the details needed to preserve correctness. Do not hide uncertainty when the task is ambiguous. After the terse draft, provide a clear final answer. Make the final answer complete enough to stand alone.
